newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S APV PLANS IPO, LISTING OF HOLDING COMPANY.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S APV PLANS IPO, LISTING OF HOLDING COMPANY.

text.p: The Hungarian privatisation agency APV Rt is planning to offer shares in a new holding company named Dominencia Rt in exchange for compensation coupons , then float the company on the Budapest Stock Exchange, an APV official said on Wednesday.
The public offering would take place in late March or early April, with the floatation coming soon thereafter, the official told Reuters.
Before the public offering, APV would transfer to Dominencia its minority stakes in a several companies, he said.
He declined to name the companies, but said that they operate in a variety of sectors, are mostly small and medium-sized and none of them are currently listed on stock exchanges.
The Dominencia deal would be modeled after Pannon-valto, a holding company owning shares in 11 firms that was floated in 1995, the official said.
He said the size of the Dominencia offering and the rate at which the coupons would be exchanged for the shares has not yet been decided.
Since 1992, the Hungarian government has been issuing compensation coupons to victims of expropriations and persecution by the country's former communist and fascist governments, and their heirs.
The coupons are mainly used in privatisation deals.
APV has minority stakes in about 200 companies, many of which are highly illiquid.
